name: POLYFORGE Asset Core
description: Canonical editable .forge.json assets with stable vertex, edge, face, corner, and operation IDs. Replays ID-based moves, edge splits, polygon extrusion, and face deletion without treating array positions as identity. Stores generator provenance, per-vertex positions/colors/skin-weight slots, per-face materials, named UV-set declarations, sockets, budgets, and a deterministic checksum. Three.js geometry is a derived product, not the source of truth.

implementations.note: Library-native canonical document, stable-ID edit replay, validation, checksums, and deterministic serialization covered by Node tests.

inputs.name: assetId
inputs.description: Dotted lowercase identity such as prop.wayfinder.

inputs.name: generationResult
inputs.description: POLYFORGE generation result used to initialize the editable polygon document.

inputs.name: assetOperations
inputs.description: Stable-ID move, split, deleteFace, and extrudeFace operations.

inputs.name: budgetLevels
inputs.description: Ordered lodN records with hero/gameplay/far/proxy bands and maximum triangle counts.

provenance: Library-native editable source foundation derived from the existing POLYFORGE brick; stable identities and canonical serialization are new, with no third-party asset content.
